description:
Go inside Pimoroni's factory to see how the hackable GitHub Universe 2026 badge comes to life. From stencil printing and high-speed pick and place machines to solder reflow ovens, discover the complete manufacturing process behind this mini handheld console. Learn how the team integrated capacitive touch controls, auto-flipping UI sensors, and custom firmware developed with GitHub Copilot.
